content.title: Empowering Nurses: This first Leadership Course sets the stage for Excellence
content.summary: The Department of Surgery, in collaboration with CIME and the Nursing Education Services, hosted its inaugural Leadership Session tailored specifically for nurses.

content.text: The Department of Surgery, in collaboration with CIME and the Nursing Education Services, hosted its inaugural Leadership Session tailored specifically for nurses. The session delved into unexplored territories of leadership within hospital environments, offering nurses a unique opportunity to refine their leadership skills.

The interactive training session engaged nurses in real-life scenarios, including instances of patient harassment to reception staff, highlighting the pivotal role of nurses in navigating complex situations and assuming leadership responsibilities.

Going beyond theoretical concepts, the Leadership Course immersed nursing professionals in high-fidelity operations scenarios, providing hands-on experience and practical insights into effective leadership strategies. The inaugural event witnessed enthusiastic participation from nurses, laying the foundation for future sessions aimed at empowering nursing staff across the board.
More than just a course, this initiative represents a significant opportunity for nurses to enhance their leadership capabilities and seamlessly integrate education with real-world complexities.
